issue_context.title: BUG: Series.is_unique does not consider single occurrences of NaN unique
issue_context.body:
#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example if possible
On `master`:
```python
In [1]: import numpy as np; import pandas as pd; pd.__version__
Out[1]: '0.25.0.dev0+67.gf04bb2fc9'

In [2]: pd.Series(['foo', 'bar', np.nan]).is_unique
Out[2]: False

In [3]: pd.Series([np.nan]).is_unique
Out[3]: False
```

Note that indexes consider the equivalent cases to be unique:
```python
In [4]: pd.Index(['foo', 'bar', np.nan]).is_unique
Out[4]: True

In [5]: pd.Float64Index([np.nan]).is_unique
Out[5]: True
```
#### Problem description
`Series.is_unique` does not consider single occurrences of `NaN` to be unique.

#### Expected Output
I'd expect `[2]` and `[3]` to be `True`.
